competences.description: Attacks with magical powers and inflicts continuous damage for 2 turns with a 50% chance. The damage increases according to Attack Speed.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

competences.description: Attacks the enemy 3 times with magic and weakens the Defense for 2 turns with a 50% chance for each attack. The damage increases according to the Attack Speed.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

effets.note: Proportionate to Attack Power and Attack Speed

competences.description: Decreases the damage taken from enemies with no harmful effects by 30% and increases the damage dealt to enemies with harmful effects by 30%. Grants Oblivion for 2 turns when you attack the enemy (boss excluded). If the target is already in the Oblivion state, increases the duration of Oblivion to 3 turns. Passive skills are not activated in the Oblivion state. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Increases damage per debuff on the target
Decreases damage received by a certain amount
effets.note: If enemy attacker has no debuffs
if the enemy is already under Oblivion state
